files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent dialogue character illustration for a Japanese dungeon RPG. A single adult character, centered waist-up composition with the complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, the lower edge ending naturally below the belt, a small transparent margin at both sides and above the head. Vertical portrait canvas. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen, worn leather and subtle brass, clean readable facial features, restrained earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, calm conversational posture and eye-level three-quarter view. Fully transparent background with clean alpha edges. Clothing and props have plain unlettered surfaces. This is one individual character asset. Subject: Navia, the oil-store record clerk, a woman in her mid thirties with dark brown hair gathered into a low bun, a broad thoughtful face, warm brown eyes and a composed, slightly concerned expression. She wears a muted plum work jacket over an oatmeal linen blouse, narrow practical sleeves and a dark leather belt. She holds a closed plain brown ledger against her torso with one arm; her other hand rests loosely along its edge. A small brass pen holder at the belt. Her silhouette and face should be distinct from a young short-bob-haired clerk.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。ナヴィア、油蔵の記帳係。30代半ばの女性。焦げ茶の髪を低い位置でまとめ、広めの思慮深い顔、茶色の目、落ち着きとわずかな心配のある表情。くすんだ葡萄色の実務用上着、生成りの麻ブラウス、革帯。無地の茶色い帳面を体の前に抱え、もう一方の手を縁に添える。腰に小さな真鍮の筆入れ。既存人物画に合わせた質感のある彩色。頭と両手が入り、腰帯の下で終わる構図。背景は透過。
